## Discovery & Translational Science

* **Identification of elemental octasulfur storage in mammals** [In the Pipeline](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/sulfur-right-there-all-along)
  * Researchers detected elemental octasulfur (S₈) in mammals, a storage form of sulfur previously recognized only in prokaryotes.
  * Discovery was enabled using Raman spectroscopy and a host-guest mass spectrometry capture method utilizing polyaromatic capsule structures.

* **Small-molecule RIG-I agonists discovered via CARD activation platform** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42897194/)
  * Researchers developed a selective caspase activation and recruitment domain (CARD) platform to identify direct-acting small-molecule agonists of retinoic acid-inducible gene I (RIG-I).

* **Antisense oligonucleotide targeting novel lipid protein prevents obesity in preclinical models** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.12.753973)
  * Weekly intraperitoneal administration of an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) targeting a novel lipid regulatory protein prevented weight gain in mouse models of diet-induced obesity.
  * The approach aims to offer weight loss without the lean mass loss and rebound observed with GLP-1 receptor agonists.

* **Perivascular thermogenic fat activation improves aortic stenosis in mice** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.13.758767)
  * Pharmacological activation of perivascular adipose tissue (PVAT) using a β₃-adrenergic agonist or cold exposure enhanced aortic distensibility and cellular remodeling in a murine model of aortic stenosis.
  * Protective effects were absent in genetic mouse models deficient in PVAT development.

* **Exercise mitigates Alzheimer's cognitive decline via microglial TMEM9 downregulation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42897611/)
  * Preclinical findings demonstrate that exercise promotes lipophagy and alleviates cognitive impairment in Alzheimer's disease models by downregulating microglial transmembrane protein 9 (TMEM9).

* **Systematic optimization of the MidTAC platform for targeted protein degradation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42897223/)
  * Characterized and systematically optimized the MidTAC platform to improve degradation efficiency and selectivity in targeted protein degradation applications.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **Rapport Therapeutics reports positive Phase 2 data for RAP-219 in bipolar mania** [BioStocks via X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112484887613559180)
  * Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 met its primary and secondary endpoints in patients with bipolar mania.
  * At Week 3, the treatment demonstrated statistically significant placebo-adjusted improvements in Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS) total score (3.1 points; p = 0.045) and CGI-BP Severity of Mania score (0.4 points; p = 0.024).

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **Disc Medicine plans NDA submission after positive Phase 3 bitopertin trial in EPP** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/Disc-bitopertin-apollo-erythropoietic-protoporphyria-study-results/833327/)
  * Bitopertin (licensed from Roche) met all primary and secondary endpoints in a Phase 3 trial for erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP), a rare disorder causing extreme light sensitivity.
  * Disc Medicine plans to submit an application to the FDA by the end of the year, targeting potential commercialization in 2027.

* **[Biotech]** **Veradermics achieves positive readout in second Phase 3 study of oral minoxidil for hair loss** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roche-hansoh-veradermics-rasonque-europe-orbimed-china-ultragenyx/833248/)
  * An extended-release oral minoxidil formulation met key endpoints in a second Phase 3 trial for male pattern baldness.
  * The study confirmed significant new hair regrowth compared to placebo over six months, mirroring results from the first Phase 3 trial.

* **[Biotech]** **Vimseltinib shows long-term efficacy and safety in Phase 3 MOTION trial for TGCT** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42898002/)
  * Long-term follow-up from the Phase 3 MOTION trial demonstrated sustained clinical response, functional improvement, and acceptable safety for vimseltinib in patients with tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT).

* **Entinostat plus exemestane overall survival evaluated in HR-positive breast cancer** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42897132/)
  * Long-term overall survival results were reported from the randomized controlled EOC103A3101 trial evaluating the HDAC inhibitor entinostat combined with exemestane in patients with hormone receptor-positive advanced breast cancer.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA grants accelerated approval to GSK’s Jemperli for dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer** [FDA Press Release](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-immunotherapy-may-allow-certain-patients-rectal-cancer-avoid-chemotherapy-radiation-and) | [FDA Approval Notice](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-dostarlimab-locally-advanced-rectal-cancer)
  * FDA granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab-gxly (Jemperli) for adult patients with untreated Stage II/III mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) locally advanced rectal cancer.
  * In the single-arm AZUR-1 trial (n = 154), patients receiving 500 mg IV every 3 weeks for nine cycles achieved high clinical complete response (cCR) rates, enabling non-operative management without chemotherapy, radiation, or surgery.

* **FDA details Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher pilot program** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/industry/commissioners-national-priority-voucher-cnpv-pilot-program)
  * FDA announced a public hearing regarding its CNPV pilot program, designed to accelerate review times using interdisciplinary, tumor board-style evaluations.
  * Target areas include public health crisis response, novel breakthrough therapies, large unmet medical needs, and supply chain/manufacturing onshoring.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **Merck KGaA acquires Silence Therapeutics for $1.3B to expand RNAi portfolio** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/merck-kgaa-rnai-13b-silence-buyout-blood-disorder-polycythemia-vera/833336/)
  * Merck KGaA agreed to acquire Silence Therapeutics for $20.00 per U.S.-listed share in cash ($1.3 billion total value, representing a 130% premium).
  * The transaction gives Merck KGaA ownership of divesiran, an siRNA therapy with positive Phase 2 data in polycythemia vera.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Roche enters $15B multi-target ADC partnership with Hansoh Pharma** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roche-hansoh-veradermics-rasonque-europe-orbimed-china-ultragenyx/833248/)
  * Roche will pay $400 million upfront and up to $15 billion in potential milestones to license two preclinical antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) from Hansoh Pharmaceutical and collaborate on additional targets.

* **Launch prices for new medicines show steep multi-year increase despite slight 2025 dip** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/20/launch-price-of-new-medicines-drop-very-slightly-2025/)
  * Analysis of 202 newly launched medicines showed median net launch prices reached $257,000, up 35% from $173,000 in 2022, despite a slight decrease in the past year.

* **China proposes restrictions on foreign acquisitions of domestic biotech technology** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/19/biotech-news-china-moves-to-restrict-foreign-biotech-acquisitons/)
  * Chinese regulatory authorities proposed restrictions on foreign acquisitions of critical biopharma technologies to retain domestic control over drug discovery assets.

## Public Health & Policy

* **Executive order establishes NIH division and task force on women’s health** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/19/executive-order-melania-trump-nih-division-on-womens-health/)
  * An executive order established a dedicated NIH division and task force focused on advancing research infrastructure and policy standards for women's health.
